title: Government Approves Pan-India Rollout of ₹60,000 Crore 'PM-SETU' ITI Skilling Scheme
summary: Upgrades 200 ITI clusters with ₹1,237.58 crore initial Strategic Investment Plans.

blocks.content: Upgrades 200 ITI clusters with ₹1,237.58 crore initial Strategic Investment Plans.

items: National Rollout: ₹60,000 crore PM-SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling & Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) rolled out across 200 clusters.
Strategic Investment Plans: Cleared 5 SIPs worth ₹1,237.58 crore to upgrade ITI clusters in Odisha, Gujarat, and Telangana.

blocks.summary: National Steering Committee chaired by MSDE Secretary Debashree Mukherjee.
